categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Adds `ci/test/wrap-fd-limit.sh` and updates CI test scripts to enforce an FD budget in the macOS native CI job.
categories.rationale: The change adds file descriptor limit wrapping to macOS CI to catch NetBSD-specific FD limit regressions in per-PR runs instead of waiting for nightly CI. This improves CI test coverage for a recurring failure mode across platforms, though it does not address core build or release integrity.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Labeled 'Tests' and changes test framework node startup logic in `test/functional/test_framework/util.py` and `test_framework/test_node.py`.
categories.rationale: The PR fixes a recurring functional test failure in `interface_ipc*.py` on NetBSD caused by `-ipcbind` file descriptors exceeding the `FD_SETSIZE` (256) limit. This restores passing test signal on NetBSD nightly runs by adjusting framework max connection limits.
